verdict.rationale: Handling SMS, WhatsApp, social or live chat alongside email is a fair question for an inbox product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only email capabilities (IMAP/POP/SMTP, the Gmail API, delegation, filters). The one non-email channel mentioned is the third-party SMS Backup+ app archiving texts into Gmail, a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, the same inbox also handles adjacent customer channels — SMS, WhatsApp, social, or live chat — beside email
